lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，身子很扁。
lines.en: I crawl flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步挪一点，像条影子。
lines.en: I shift a little at a time, like a shadow.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，个头不大。
lines.en: I come out of a crack, none too big.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有倒刺，你别碰。
lines.en: I have barbs on my shell. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 我绕到你脚后，动作很轻。
lines.en: I circle behind your feet. Quietly.
I creep along the tiles by inches.

lines.zh: 我在草丛下面走，草不动。
lines.en: I move beneath the grass and it doesn't stir.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，几乎贴地。
lines.en: I keep so low I'm nearly flat.
I crawl from the wall base onto the threshold.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下细痕。
lines.en: I leave fine marks where I pass.

lines.zh: 我往阴影里走，那里才好藏。
lines.en: I go into the shade. Easier to hide.

lines.zh: 我一停下来，就跟石头一样。
lines.en: When I stop, I'm just another stone.
I lie in the dark, my back arched.

lines.zh: 我的刺在光下有一点亮。
lines.en: My barbs catch a little light.
I don't start things. I watch.

lines.zh: 有个虫爬过来，我让开了。
lines.en: An insect crawled over and I moved aside.

lines.zh: 我身上的壳很硬，十八点的护甲。
lines.en: My shell is hard. Eighteen points of it.
I'm waiting for someone to make the first move.

lines.zh: 这一带的地面，我摸得很熟。
lines.en: I know this ground well.
I tuck my legs under me and hold still.

lines.zh: 我把头贴在石头上，凉快。
lines.en: I rest my head on the stone. Cool.

lines.zh: 我这副身板，适合守着一个地方。
lines.en: This frame of mine suits guarding one spot.

lines.zh: 你踩到我旁边那块石头了。
lines.en: You stepped on the stone beside me.
I only move if you step on me.
Back away and I'll pretend I didn't see.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你低头才看得见。
lines.en: I'm this low. You'd have to look down.
My barbs aren't decoration.

lines.zh: 你的影子落到我身上了。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen on me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: What's in your hand doesn't interest me.

lines.zh: 我扁扁地贴着地爬，像一道影子。
lines.en: I crawl flat along the ground like a shadow.
If you're going to try, try once.

lines.zh: 我压得很低，你不好打我。
lines.en: I'm pressed low. Hard to hit.
I press even lower.

lines.zh: 这一下我的壳响了一声。
lines.en: That made my shell crack audibly.
Eighteen armor plates, moving low to the ground.

lines.zh: 我没有退远，只是转了方向。
lines.en: I didn't back far. Only changed angle.
My shell can take this much.
My barbs are still there. Intact.
I crawl back slowly. Unhurried.

lines.zh: 这一下让我贴地更紧了。
lines.en: That pressed me flatter still.
Low to the ground, I still pierce.
I'm waiting. Always waiting.
Set it down. I'll look.
Food off the ground, I won't touch.
It's catching the light. I can't make it out.
I wait for the bug to stop before I move.

lines.zh: 你手举得太高，我够不着。
lines.en: Your hand's too high for me to reach.

lines.zh: 这点东西，换不来我挪窝。
lines.en: That won't move me from here.
I shift half a step and stop.
Step back and I'll go.
One sniff and I'm done with it.
If you mean it, throw it farther.
You touched my barbs. Back away.
I'm not heavy, and you can't shove me.
That pressed me to the ground.
Your foot nearly came down on me.

lines.zh: 我往石缝那边缩了半寸。
lines.en: I shrink half an inch toward the crack.

lines.zh: 你的靴子边刮到我的壳。
lines.en: Your boot's edge scraped my shell.
We're crowded. I move first.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的腿乱了一下。
lines.en: That tangled my legs a moment.
One of my barbs is in you.

lines.zh: 我贴着地不动，你就过去了。
lines.en: I lie flat and you pass by.
I don't mean that.
Move your hand away from my face.
I'm all barbs. Not suitable.

lines.zh: 这地方太开阔，我不放心。
lines.en: Too open here. I'm not easy.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢贴着石头待着。
lines.en: I prefer lying against stone.
Come close and you'll get pricked.
That needs cover.
I don't start things. Same here.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就当你没说过。
lines.en: Move back and I'll forget you said it.
I just want to stay quiet.
I sweep it under me.
I pin it with a foreleg and look.

lines.zh: 我背上的甲，比石头还硬。
lines.en: The shell on my back is harder than stone.
It slipped into the crack.
My legs are too short to grip it.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在壳上，带着走。
lines.en: I balance it on my shell and carry it.
I won't touch that food on the ground.
I edge over and press it down.
That's too hard to crack.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进石缝里压住。
lines.en: I wedge it under a stone and press.
You've stepped onto my ground.
I stay flat. You stop too.
My barbs are already up.

lines.zh: 你站在我唯一的出口上。
lines.en: You're standing in my only way out.
I stay flat and wait for your move.
This spot is narrow. No dodging.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的时候，我就动了。
lines.en: When you lift that foot, I move.

lines.zh: 我的壳贴住地面，不好撬。
lines.en: My shell is flat to the ground. Hard to pry.

lines.zh: 我盯住它，六条腿都没动。
lines.en: I've fixed on it; all six legs are still.
I'll remember what's in your hand.
Bend down and you leave a gap.
I won't be the one to start.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个走这条路的。
lines.en: You're not the first to come this way.

lines.zh: 我贴着这块石头，等一个机会。
lines.en: I keep to this stone and wait for a chance.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖离我只有半格。
lines.en: Your knee is half a block from me.
My spines are all raised; don't touch.
I trail you flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，影子到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you go, the shadow goes.

lines.zh: 我在石头后面，等你转身。
lines.en: I'm behind the stone, waiting for you to turn.
You're not looking, so I stay still.
This close, one pounce lands.
You keep walking toward the corner.

lines.zh: 我只在你侧面，不在前面。
lines.en: I stay on your flank, never the front.
When you look down, I shift forward.
I'll wait here. No rush.
When you lift your foot, I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头挪到那块，慢慢来。
lines.en: Stone to stone, taking my time.

lines.zh: 你在门口犹豫，我就等着。
lines.en: You hesitate at the door. I'll wait.
I hold still until you come near.

lines.zh: 你的光扫过来，我又躲回暗处。
lines.en: Your light sweeps past and I slip back into the dark.

lines.zh: 这一片地砖，中间高两边低。
lines.en: These floor tiles slope from the middle.
I heard you shift your weight.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我就往前挪一格。
lines.en: Three steps back for you, one block forward for me.
I'm always at your back-side.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在石头上打滑了。
lines.en: Your boot slipped on the stone.
I press to the ground, spines up.
I ram you; my barbs arrive first.

lines.zh: 这一下扎在你的靴面上。
lines.en: That pricked your boot.
I drive my whole shell into your foot.
You pull back and I withdraw at once.
That one had everything behind it.
You stamp and I slip aside.
A barb snagged your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我自己的壳也响。
lines.en: That knocked my own shell too.
You lift a foot and I roll clear.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，但是很疼。
lines.en: Not heavy, but it stings.

lines.zh: 我撞你的脚背，刺先挨上。
lines.en: I hit your instep, barbs first.
That pricked into your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边滚过去，再翻回来。
lines.en: I roll past your foot and back again.
You kick and I skate along the ground.
That one I hit you with my shell tucked in.
You backed two steps onto bad footing.
That one caught your ankle square.

lines.zh: 我伏着不动，等你折回来。
lines.en: I stay flat and wait for you to circle back.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西掉了，我压住它。
lines.en: You dropped it. I've pinned it.

lines.zh: 这一撞之后，我立刻缩回去。
lines.en: After that hit I withdraw at once.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里爬出来，背甲刮着岩。
lines.en: I crawl out of the crevice, my shell scraping rock.
I keep to this shade.

lines.zh: 我的壳和石头颜色差不多。
lines.en: My shell is near the color of stone.

lines.zh: 有人挪开了这块石头，我露了出来。
lines.en: Someone moved that stone and exposed me.
I crawled a long way along the wall's base.
I'm under a pile of dead branches.

lines.zh: 我从土里顶出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil and shake.
I come up through a gap in the tiles.
I slip into a crack, only my spines showing.

lines.zh: 有人踩碎了一块砖，我露出来了。
lines.en: Someone cracked a tile and exposed me.

lines.zh: 我在门槛下面待了一会儿。
lines.en: I waited a while under the threshold.

lines.zh: 我从石堆里爬出来，很慢。
lines.en: I crawl out of the rubble. Slowly.

lines.zh: 热一上来，我赶紧往石缝里钻。
lines.en: The heat comes and I dive for the crack.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，壳磕了一下。
lines.en: I fall off the step and my shell knocks.

lines.zh: 水一淹，我往下沉得很快。
lines.en: Water covers me and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到墙上，贴了一会儿。
lines.en: The blast slams me to the wall and I stick.

lines.zh: 有东西打在我的壳上，滑开了。
lines.en: Something struck my shell and glanced off.

lines.zh: 有股力把我按住，我动不了。
lines.en: A force holds me still.

lines.zh: 好久没吃到东西，我懒得动。
lines.en: No food for long. I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的腿全缩进去了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my legs pull in.

lines.zh: 底下没有地，我还在往下坠。
lines.en: No ground below, and I keep falling.
